job.title: Controls Testing & Monitoring Officer
job.description:
• End-to-end control testing, monitoring and remediation, working closely with the Head of Governance & Assurance.
  • Build the dashboards and monitoring tools that shape the control environment.
  • Sydney based. Permanent, full time. Hybrid 50/50.
The Role

Working closely with the Head of Governance & Assurance, you will design, supervise and execute risk-based control testing plans. You'll provide the tested evidence that underpins certification and audit cycles and partner with IT, governance and external stakeholders to close control gaps. You will also be responsible for:
  • Running control testing, including walkthroughs, sampling and evidence review.
  • Identifying and assessing control deficiencies and recommending remediation.
  • Developing and maintaining monitoring dashboards to track compliance metrics.
  • Reporting regularly to the Head of Governance & Assurance on testing outcomes and issues.
  • Managing the issues and remediation register through to timely closure.
  • Supporting governance models and compliance obligation mapping.
  • Leading awareness and testing across competition and conflicts of interest, segregation of duties, delegated authorities and governance models.
Skills and Experience

You'll be a detail-oriented, tech-savvy controls specialist who is comfortable with data-driven insights and finds better ways to monitor and test.
  • 6+ years' experience in risk management, compliance and/or controls testing.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing risk-based control testing plans.
  • Strong skills in building monitoring dashboards and tracking compliance metrics.
  • Experience managing issues and remediation registers to timely resolution.
  • Knowledge of governance models, obligation mapping, conflicts of interest and segregation of duties.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with adaptability and resilience across competing priorities.
  • Excellent stakeholder skills and a collaborative style.
  • Relevant risk or compliance qualifications and experience in a regulated industry or professional services are highly regarded.
Benefits

Your work will directly strengthen an organisation that helps fight fraud and scams across Australia.
  • Real ownership and autonomy over your deliverables, with influence on business strategy.
  • Direct access to decision-makers.
  • Variety and impact from servicing the entire business.
  • Flexible hybrid model and a culture that respects boundaries.
  • Smart, approachable and non-hierarchical colleagues.
How to Apply

job.title: Senior Manager, Corporate Secretarial
job.description:
• Senior leadership role overseeing company secretarial for a global fs business.
  • Mentor and grow a capable team while owning key client relationships.
  • Package 190K-200K + annual bonus. Sydney based, hybrid working.
A leading global financial services business is seeking an experienced Senior Manager to lead the delivery of company secretarial services to a diverse portfolio of clients. This is a fantastic opportunity for a governance professional ready to step into a leadership role with genuine scope for impact, autonomy, and career progression.

As Senior Manager, you'll own the delivery of company secretarial services across a varied client base, ensuring every engagement is precise, compliant, and client-focused.

Key areas of focus include:
  • Oversee day-to-day delivery of company secretarial services, ensuring statutory and regulatory obligations are met accurately, on time, and in line with client expectations.
  • Build and maintain trusted client relationships, lead onboarding of new accounts, and translate client needs into practical governance solutions.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, managing workloads, supporting professional growth, and driving a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, enhance service delivery, and contribute to operational excellence and business development initiatives.
  • Ensure all work meets legislative and regulatory requirements, maintaining high standards of governance and risk management.
You'll bring a combination of technical expertise, leadership capability, and a genuine passion for governance best practice. Ideally, you'll have:
  • A minimum of 8 years' relevant experience in company secretarial or corporate governance services, including at least 2 years in a management or team leadership capacity.
  • A Chartered Secretary qualification (ACG/FCG) or an equivalent governance credential is highly regarded, though candidates with strong equivalent experience will also be considered.
  • Sound knowledge of corporate governance principles, statutory compliance requirements, and company secretarial best practice.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to liaise effectively with clients, colleagues, and offices across multiple jurisdictions.
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach, paired with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
This is a chance to build a long-term career with a business that values its people. Benefits include:
  • A supportive, collaborative team culture within a global organisation.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
  • Exposure to a diverse client portfolio and cross-border governance work.
  • Hybrid working flexibility, brand new offices in the CBD
  • A comprehensive benefits package (specifics to be confirmed).
If you're an experienced governance professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Manager - Risk Advisory (Regulatory & Compliance)
job.description:
• Hands-on advisory role embedded within a top risk practice.
  • Sit alongside renowned legal teams and General Counsel’s from day one on strategic, high-profile matters.
  • Genuine consulting work across banking, insurance, superannuation and asset management.
  • Sydney based. Permanent role. Circa $170k to $200k package, commensurate with experience, plus bonus up to 25% of remuneration.
The Role

Reporting into a highly regarded leadership team, you'll play a hands-on role advising clients on risk management, regulatory and compliance matters, with a strong focus on regulated financial services. You'll design and implement risk management frameworks, deliver regulatory compliance advice and governance reviews, and support clients through regulatory enforcement and investigation matters, often working as a strategic partner rather than a downstream reviewer.

You'll act as a conduit between junior team members and firm leadership, playing a genuine hands-on role in team development while starting to build your own business development and pipeline profile. Expect to work on ambiguous, novel engagements with no set template, so a problem-solving mindset and comfort operating without a playbook are essential.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide strategic risk and regulatory advice to tier-1 clients across banking, insurance, superannuation and asset management.
  • Design and implement risk management frameworks and lead regulatory compliance advice and governance reviews.
  • Support regulatory enforcement and investigation matters, working closely with legal teams and clients' General Counsel.
  • Act as a conduit between junior consultants and firm leadership, playing a hands-on role in team development.
  • Deliver clear, insightful written reports and recommendations to client risk teams and executives.
  • Collaborate across the firm with M&A, public sector and other specialist teams on cross-disciplinary engagements.
Desired Experience
  • 6 to 8 years' consulting experience, ideally gained within a top-tier or major professional services firm. This is a genuine advisory role, so a consulting background is essential.
  • Strong risk management and regulatory compliance experience within financial services. Non-financial risk, operational risk or compliance backgrounds are highly valued; financial risk experience will also be considered.
  • Solid understanding of the Australian regulatory landscape, including APRA, ASIC and AUSTRAC.
  • You’ll bring well-developed technical knowledge, sound judgement and strong critical thinking.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and connecting the dots without a template to follow.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and present clearly and persuasively in writing.
  • An agile, hungry mindset and a genuine appetite to do exceptional work alongside industry-leading practitioners.
Benefits
  • Clear, merit-based promotion pathway with a transparent capability framework setting out what's expected at each level.
  • Work on high-profile matters that shape regulatory precedent and market practice, and the chance to build a genuine personal brand alongside industry leaders.
  • Genuine investment in AI and technology tools to support how you work.
  • Up to 26 weeks' paid parental leave, with the flexibility to take it over a year, plus a full year of paid superannuation and no minimum tenure requirement.
  • Option to purchase additional annual leave.
  • A collegial, high-calibre team environment with strong cross-firm collaboration.

job.title: Risk and Compliance Analyst
job.description:
This is a genuinely hands-on role for someone who wants real breadth in their risk role, spanning incident management, board-level reporting and ownership of a core risk system.

Join a close-knit Risk and Compliance team at a well-regarded insurance provider that's actively investing in growing the function.
  • Hands-on Risk and Compliance Analyst role with genuine variety across incident management, reporting and Protecht system ownership
  • Growing risk function backed by strong executive and board support, with a genuine pathway to progress
  • $100k + Super | Hybrid role, 2 days in the office (Thursdays are a must)
The Role

Reporting diretly to the CRO, you'll act as a support function for the broader team while driving several initiatives in your own right. It's a role that rewards someone with sharp attention to detail and the lateral thinking to understand not just how a risk framework is designed, but how it actually plays out day to day. The business is putting more resource behind risk and compliance, so there's a clear runway here for someone who wants to build on this role over time.

Key Responsibilities
  • Protecht administration sits with you, from managing day-to-day system changes to delivering training and support across the business
  • Incident coordination is a core part of the role, triaging incidents as they're logged, assessing severity, assigning ownership and guiding issues through to closure
  • Reporting and insights you'll own, including weekly incident reports, Power BI reporting built alongside the data analytics team, and quarterly Non-Financial Risk reporting for the risk committee and board
  • Controls assurance and reviews round out the role, giving you extra exposure to additional assurance work and ad hoc reviews as they come up
Desired Experience
  • 3+ years' experience in a risk, compliance or controls-related role, ideally within financial services or another regulated industry
  • Genuine hands-on experience with Protecht or a similar Enterprise Risk Management system
  • A background in incident management, root cause analysis or controls assurance, with the analytical rigour to properly unpack detail
  • Confidence preparing reporting and insights for senior stakeholders and committees
  • Tertiary qualification in a business-related discipline; risk management accreditation is a plus
  • A critical, lateral thinker who's driven rather than simply capable, and who can see the bigger picture behind the process
Benefits
  • Genuine and well-supported pathway to grow within an expanding risk function
  • Hybrid working, 2 days per week in the office (Thursdays essential)
  • A small, tight-knit team environment backed by real executive investment in risk maturity
  • Broad exposure across systems, incident management, reporting and assurance, ideal for someone wanting to round out their risk and compliance skill set early
How to Apply
